analysis:
The PR changes docs/architecture/inference.md only in two places, a "Last updated" date (line 3) and a source path for GatedDeltaPrefill (line 609, from Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift to Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDelta.swift). Both are documentation edits with no code, configuration, protocol or deployment change. I reviewed the two head-text units (lines 416-1227) and the patch excerpt.

The surrounding text describes the Nemotron Super slot, GLM5Next boundaries, calibration, the prefix cache and the request path. None of it is altered. It stays consistent with the cache-scope partitioning and the accepted SEC-035 timing oracle in T-041, and with the coordinator-authored cacheSalt. Statements on the GatedDelta kernel (bit-exact selection against the stock kernel, so checkpoint capture is unaffected) are unchanged and only their file pointer moved.

No threat-model assumptions are invalidated and no mitigation is weakened. The file-path correction is a docs-accuracy change. I could not verify here that the new path exists in libs/mlx-swift-lm; that is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security conclusion. No new attack surface was identified, and no threat-model update is required.
